title: Hangs or Crashes on .exe launch (v4.4.dev7+)
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in: v4.4.dev7, v4.4.beta1, v4.4.stable, v4.4.1.stable, v4.5.dev4
- Not reproducible in: v4.3.stable, v4.4.dev4, v4.4.dev6

### System information

Windows 11 Pro, V24H2  - Godot 4.4.dev7

### Issue description

Ever since 4.4 released, I have been unable to launch the project manager from the executable and opted to stay with 4.3 since I was just starting out. Recently I looked through the bug reports but could not find the same problem, or a working solution.

Launching Godot 4.4.dev7 (or later) through the command prompt gives the following:
```
"C:\Users\Etjoh\Desktop\Game Making\Godot\old versions\4.4-dev7\Godot_v4.4-dev7_win64.exe" -d -v

C:\Users\Etjoh>WorkerThreadPool: 16 threads, 4 max low-priority.
Godot Engine v4.4.dev7.official.46c8f8c5c - https://godotengine.org
TextServer: Added interface "Dummy"
TextServer: Added interface "ICU / HarfBuzz / Graphite (Built-in)"
Native OpenGL API detected: 3.3: NVIDIA - NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2080 SUPER
NVAPI: Init OK!
NVAPI: Disabled OpenGL threaded optimization successfully
NVAPI: Disabled G-SYNC for windowed mode successfully

================================================================
CrashHandlerException: Program crashed with signal 11
Engine version: Godot Engine v4.4.dev7.official (46c8f8c5c5874c7c56ea5b1384259de9402d3449)
Dumping the backtrace. Please include this when reporting the bug to the project developer.
```
Sometimes I will not get a crash and it will stall after disabling G-SYNC. I also notice this outside of the command prompt, as the mouse icon will periodically (every couple seconds) indicate it is trying to load something, seemingly indefinitely:
```
C:\Users\Etjoh>WorkerThreadPool: 16 threads, 4 max low-priority.
Godot Engine v4.4.dev7.official.46c8f8c5c - https://godotengine.org
TextServer: Added interface "Dummy"
TextServer: Added interface "ICU / HarfBuzz / Graphite (Built-in)"
Native OpenGL API detected: 3.3: NVIDIA - NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2080 SUPER
NVAPI: Init OK!
NVAPI: Disabled OpenGL threaded optimization successfully
NVAPI: Disabled G-SYNC for windowed mode successfully
```
When I check Event Viewer, I see an error about faulting module ntdll, regardless of if the process stalls or crashes:
```
Faulting application name: Godot_v4.4-dev7_win64.exe, version: 4.4.0.0, time stamp: 0x67630b46
Faulting module name: ntdll.dll, version: 10.0.22621.5124, time stamp: 0x82bfa2b9
Exception code: 0xc0000374
Fault offset: 0x000000000010cbb9
Faulting process id: 0x0x2B70
Faulting application start time: 0x0x1DBD17EE3DA08C6
Faulting application path: C:\Users\Etjoh\Desktop\Game Making\Godot\old versions\4.4-dev7\Godot_v4.4-dev7_win64.exe
Faulting module path: C:\Windows\SYSTEM32\ntdll.dll
Report Id: 6f063e84-cbeb-414f-8f88-24db788c59fc
Faulting package full name: 
Faulting package-relative application ID: 
```

### Steps to reproduce

- Download Godot v4.4-dev7 or later
- Open the associated executable

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

N/A
